response_text: {"decomposition_id":"D6","label":"Codified Risk-Governance Framework Duties","object":"Board and senior management responsibilities for the risk-governance framework and strategy, relocated from SR 12-17 into Regulation YY","consolidated_text":"A covered institution shall maintain a risk-governance framework consistent with the governance attributes set out at s:GOV-02 through s:GOV-13 (as relocated from SR 12-17).
